findings.failing_input: Operator POSTs scope='all'; 7 DATA_TABLES need DELETE.
findings.expected: Parallel deletes (Promise.allSettled) — 7 independent table deletes can fire concurrently; sequential adds 6× latency for no semantic gain.
findings.actual: Sequential for-loop; each table delete awaits the previous. On large datasets (≥100k orders_attribution rows), each delete can take seconds → total 30s+ wall time. The operator UI shows a spinner that may even time out the 60s maxDuration. Same family as API-23 (operator/jobs N+1).
findings.fix_sketch: Replace the for loop with `const results = await Promise.allSettled(tables.map(table => supabase.from(table).delete({count: 'exact'}).not('store_id', 'is', null)))`. Map each result into `deleted` / `errors`.
findings.regression_test_idea: Mock 7 deletes with 200ms each; assert handler returns in <500ms (parallel) rather than >1.4s (sequential).

findings.failing_input: Future migration adds a row to data_daily with store_id intentionally NULL (e.g. cross-store aggregate sentinel).
findings.expected: The reset filter must still match every row.
findings.actual: The store_id NOT NULL constraint on all 7 tables makes the filter universal TODAY. But the comment on line 51-66 explicitly documents this brittle assumption. A future schema change that adds a nullable store_id would silently leak rows past the reset without test failure.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace .not('store_id', 'is', null) with a more robust always-true filter: .or('store_id.is.null,store_id.not.is.null') — verbose but TRULY universal. OR pin the assumption with a migration-time test that fails CI if any DATA_TABLES gains a nullable store_id.
findings.regression_test_idea: Add a migration linter (or test) that introspects pg_catalog and asserts every DATA_TABLES.store_id has NOT NULL.

findings.failing_input: All 7 deletes succeed with count=0 (already empty).

uncertainty_notes: Confirm-token defense-in-depth is well-tested. Per-table try/catch isolation is good. The sequential loop (API-32) is the only real issue for operator UX.
test_coverage_gaps: POST handler: NOT covered (mock supabase + assert delete called for each table, total counts).
Partial-failure path: NOT covered (one table throws, others succeed → response.errors populated).
